title: Osmani TV v24 subscription policy — App/Admin production handoff
deployment_order: Admin AI deploys and verifies backend/database/payment/VPS
App AI performs final production E2E

payment_entry_contract.app_behavior: Fail closed. Package prices and payment methods remain hidden until the current device identity receives an authoritative active=false response.

active_response.required_behavior: Block checkout and show the supplied Swahili active-package dialog.

create_order_server_guard.semantics: Atomically reject create-order if the resolved device/install identity already has any active subscription. This closes the verify-to-create race.

same_phone_identity_contract.rule: A payment phone is transaction contact data, never subscription ownership.
same_phone_identity_contract.compatibility: Do not rebind or delete existing subscriptions during identity strengthening.

account_display_contract.rule: Return metadata for the one currently assigned subscription, not accumulated historical plan durations.
account_display_contract.app_display: Remaining and duration values are capped to the matched assigned plan. This is display-only and never mutates subscription data.

new_expiry_contract.applies_to: subscriptions created after Admin migration only

sse_required.targeting: Every event must include order_id and/or a strong device identity. Untargeted global success events are not trusted for instant unlock.

admin_confirmation_required_before_ota: same phone can create independent device-bound subscriptions
